In many ethical frameworks, there's a concept of a duty to help others when you can. However, there might be factors like Bob's own safety, the severity of the child's injury, or if he didn't notice the child. But the scenario doesn't mention any of these mitigating factors. In deontology, there might be a duty to assist.
